snippet.title: Glyph 2
snippet.description:
The distant world of Kuros is gripped by the forces of dangerous shadow elements. As an exile, trained in the forces of light and dark, you must harness the energy of Wood, Fire, Water, Metal, and Aether. Save the beautiful planet by uncovering the ancient Glyph Energy buried deep below the surface. Rebuild long lost ancient structures in one of two challenging modes, Quest or Action. Unleash 250 action-packed levels in Glyph 2, an ethereal Adventure game.

http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/3774/glyph-2/index.html
